'''Cathar''' was the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Species/Legends|species]], filled with many ecological niches and huge insect predators.

==Description==
[[File:Oldrepublic_27_103.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The Cathar landscape.]]

The natives lived in [[city-tree]]s, while wide areas of the planet were made barren by [[kiltik]] beetles.

The [[Giant horned hopper]] were often killed by the Cathar species in blood hunts.

==History==
The planet was conquered by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] during the [[Battle of Cathar]], leading to the enslavement and near-extinction of the Cathar species. The few survivors were forced to flee offworld to survive. After the end of the [[Mandalorian Wars]] Cathar began to resettle their world and by the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], it had fully recovered from the damage the Mandalorians had done. Prior to the planet's devastation, it was not a member of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

[[File:Oldrepublic_27_10.jpg|thumb|left|150px|A Cathar [[city-tree]].]]
Cathar was [[Battle of Cathar (Yuuzhan Vong War)|conquered]] by the Yuuzhan Vong during the Yuuzhan Vong War. The invaders overran the planet prior to [[Battle of Coruscant (Yuuzhan Vong War)|their attack]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] in [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]].<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The 1996 PC game [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] mistakenly places this planet in the [[Abrion sector/Legends|Abrion sector]]. The planet is really in the [[Quelii sector/Legends|Quelii sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] at coordinates N-6 according to ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.

In ''The Essential Atlas'' Cathar is also plotted at N-7 on the map of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]]. This was confirmed to be a mistake by [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="JCF Jason Fry">{{JCFCite|url=posts/30830499|board=Literature|thread=The Essential Atlas and Galactic Cartography: Official Discussion|user=Jasonfry|date=2010-03-22|time=11:19 PM|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20200802111954/https://boards.theforce.net/threads/the-essential-atlas-and-galactic-cartography-official-discussion.21938930/page-139}}</ref>
